content.name: ATF Freyr Battlecarrier (9.0+)
content.description:
[h1]ATF Freyr Battlecarrier[/h1] [hr][/hr] [h2]Description[/h2] Designed to be the successor to the Odin and Woden-class of carriers, Freyr-class was to be the next generation of ATF flagship. Freyr-class are currently operated by the Terran Protectorate in expeditionary and defensive roles. [img]https://imgur.com/29nBTDe.jpg[/img]
Also [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/x4foundations/mods/1599/] available on Nexus! [/url]
[h2]Features[/h2] [list] [*] 18 S docks and 1 M dock [*] 72 S Ship capacity [*] 12 L turrets [*] 44 M turrets [*] 3 XL Shields [/list]
[h2]QnA[/h2] Q: How can I get a Freyr? A: Terran Protectorate sell Freyr as a blueprint only like other ATF ships. Or you could test your self by boarding one!
Q: Is this competible with VRO? A: https://www.nexusmods.com/x4foundations/mods/1601 with thanks to X4RE Team for creating the VRO patch.
Q: Save game compatible? A: Safe to add mid-game, can not be removed once added.
Q: I play on pre-9.0 version of X4 and it crashes the game A: The pre-9.0 version of Freyr can be downloaded from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/x4foundations/mods/1599/] Nexus Mods [/url]
